title: Coax .env.json environment file
description: One environment for a Coax workspace directory. Lives next to .http files and applies to everything in that directory and below. Secret values are never stored in this file — only a secretId pointing at the local OS keychain entry. (A legacy shape with a top-level `scopes` array is still accepted on read; Coax always writes this flat shape.)

name.description: Environment name shown in the env switcher (e.g. "dev", "production").

key.description: Variable name, referenced in requests as {{key}}.

valuePlain.description: Plaintext value substituted at send time.

secretId.description: Stable identifier for the OS-keychain entry holding the actual value. Portable across machines: teammates get this id from git but supply the secret on their own machine.
